references.text: Parallel text describing the same measurements for the courtyard hangings: fifteen cubits with three pillars and three sockets on one side of the gate.
Parallel text describing the hanging on the other side of the gate, also fifteen cubits with three pillars and three sockets.
Continuation of the description of the courtyard hangings, showing the symmetrical construction on both sides of the entrance.
Describes the pillars and sockets used in the tabernacle, demonstrating the same construction principle of pillars and sockets.
Earlier instructions regarding pillars and sockets in the tabernacle, illustrating the consistent use of these elements in the sanctuary's construction.
Summarizes the same components described in detail; confirms that hangings and pillars were essential parts of the gate.
